I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. All three platforms fail on hard rules, and each has a minimum-change fix in the suggested copy.

- **X:** It uses bold markdown (`**coding**`). The fix drops the asterisks, giving 250 of 255 characters.
- **LinkedIn:** It uses the banned phrase "excited to announce". The fix drops that opening sentence, which leaves roughly 1,188 of 2,950 characters. I estimated that count by hand and didn't run the character-count check on it.
- **Bluesky:** It's a single paragraph and needs two. The fix splits it after the second sentence, giving 264 of 300 characters.

I didn't read the blog post, so the specifics in the copy (Engin Diri, the 33 agent skills, the two workshops) are unchecked against it. All three fixes only remove text or add a paragraph break. I skipped the sub-agent critique loop and the advisory suggestions pass. The X and Bluesky counts are from `len()`. No PR comment was posted.
